matches.title: Kasimpasa vs Kayserispor
matches.description: Watch Kasimpasa vs Kayserispor highlights and goals from Süper Lig on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 28, 2026. The Süper Lig atmosphere was charged as Kasimpasa hosted Kayserispor in a crucial league encounter. Both sides looked to assert their dominance from the opening whistle in a clash that promised tactical discipline and high energy. Early Breakthrough and Benedyczak's Impact On 2026-08-28 , fans had barely settled into their seats before the match saw its first decisive moment. In the 6th minute, Kasimpasa orchestrated a fluid move that saw Claudio Winck deliver a pinpoint assist. Forward Adrian Benedyczak stayed composed to slot the ball home, giving the home side an early lead and setting the tone for the afternoon. Following the opening goal, the match turned into a gritty midfield battle. Kayserispor searched for an immediate response, but Kasimpasa remained organized at the back. As the intensity grew, the referee was forced to reach for his pocket, issuing a yellow card to Jakob Vestergaard Jessen in the 39th minute. The half concluded with the hosts maintaining their narrow advantage despite increasing pressure. Tactical Shifts and Defensive Resilience The second half began with both managers looking to the bench for inspiration. Ali Kol replaced Marcus Rafferty for the hosts, while Kayserispor made a bold triple substitution near the hour mark. Mame Baba Thiam , Ayberk Karapo , and Emircan Gurluk were introduced to inject fresh energy into the visitors' pursuit of an equalizer. The final stages of the contest were characterized by a flurry of bookings and strategic changes. Matei Cristian Ilie , Ahmed Ildiz , and Ayberk Karapo all received yellow cards as frustrations boiled over. Kasimpasa managed the closing minutes expertly, introducing Ahmet Taha Dagbasi and Emirhan Boz to bolster their defense. When the final whistle blew, the early strike proved to be the difference in a hard-fought contest.
